1510621.title: Check default settings on diag page
1510621.result: All the three options are available in diag page
1510621.steps:
Navigate to diag page URL: https://Firewall-IP/sonicui/7/m/mgmt/settings/diag
Verify following option are available in diag page
a)Serve HTTP redirect pages in the DP
b)Internal TCP port number for redirecting unauthenticated HTTPS connections into the web server
c)FLUSH CACHED REDIRECT FILES
